objective: Preallocate materialized CTE schema columns from known output column counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate materialized CTE schema columns
tasks.result: Materialized CTE schema construction now preallocates column metadata from the known CTE output width.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves CTE output column order, alias column names, inferred temporary column types, temporary row writes, and recursive CTE replacement behavior.
